items.title: RSMR co-founder Geoff Mills to retire after six-decade career
items.summary: Geoff Mills, co-founder of fund ratings firm RSMR, is stepping down from the business at the end of the year.

items.title: European bomb hoaxes raise commercial insurance and non-damage disruption questions
items.summary: Recent waves of email bomb hoaxes targeting schools and aviation across Europe have exposed potential cover gaps for non-damage business interruption and administrative costs.

items.title: Marsh launches Cyber Aviation insurance form for airlines
items.summary: Global professional services firm Marsh has introduced Cyber Aviation, a tailored cyber insurance solution designed to address interconnected IT and operational risks in the aviation sector.

items.title: Markel, Marsh and Consilium announce senior London Market hires
items.summary: Markel, Marsh and Consilium have made senior appointments across London Market underwriting and reinsurance broking.

items.title: Care sector insurers face rising challenges in document retention and long-tail abuse claims
items.summary: Markel UK care underwriting head Wendy Cotton highlights how CQC inspection scores and historical record-keeping affect long-tail liability defences.

items.title: Lloyd's appoints Stephen O'Hearn to Council as Fiona Luck prepares to step down
items.summary: Stephen O'Hearn will join the Council of Lloyd's as an independent nominated non-executive member in March 2027.
